capabilities: Link installed plugins to a local dev build folder and dev command
Toggle between prod and dev builds with one click via a shadow dev plugin id
Run, kill, and restart the dev build's npm dev server from settings
Switch git branches in the dev repo with stash handling for dirty trees
Mirror dev build output into a watched dev folder so Hot Reload picks up changes
disambiguation: Not a general plugin manager; it only touches plugins you explicitly link for development.
extras: Not yet on the Community Plugins list (submission pending); install via BRAT or Hot Reload's GitHub releases approach. Desktop only — mobile shows the registry but lacks dev-server and git controls. Uses Obsidian's undocumented internal plugin manager, which the author flags as a potential future breakage point.
intentEvidence: depends on pjeby's Hot Reload (MIT licensed) and does not work without it
motivation: The author saw a gap between BRAT, Hot Reload, and existing dev-loop plugins, none of which combine a dev/prod registry, a one-click toggle, and dev-server control.
problem: Obsidian keys plugins by folder id, so a dev and prod build of the same plugin can't coexist, forcing plugin developers to manually swap builds to test changes.

relations.evidence: This plugin depends on pjeby's Hot Reload (MIT licensed) and does not work without it.
Inspired by the gap between BRAT, Hot Reload, and the many small dev-loop plugins in this space

summary: Developer tool that links installed plugins to local dev builds and one-click toggles between dev and live versions with hot reload and dev-server control.
